title: TeamVillagerDiscounts
description: Team Villager Discounts is a Paper/Spigot plugin that adds team-based villager trading benefits. When a player in a team cures a villager, all team members share the resulting trade discounts, encouraging cooperative gameplay and group progression.
body:
TeamVillagerDiscounts is a Paper/Spigot plugin that adds team-based villager trading discounts to your server. When a player cures a villager, the resulting trade discounts are shared across all members of their team, encouraging cooperation and shared progression in survival gameplay.

Players can create and manage teams easily using simple in-game commands:

/vteam create [name] – Create a new team
/vteam add <player> – Add a player to your team (owner only)
/vteam remove <player> – Remove a player from your team (owner only)
/vteam leave – Leave your current team
/vteam list – View team members
/vteam disband – Delete your team (owner only)
